# ghost/gpa-calculator

GPA Calculator (F-Droid): pick UG or MBA grading, add courses with credit and grade, read the semester GPA. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/gpa-calculator
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/gpa-calculator set_scheme --device <serial> --param scheme=<scheme>
ghost skill run ghost/gpa-calculator add_course --device <serial> --param credit=<credit> --param grade=<grade>
ghost skill run ghost/gpa-calculator get_courses --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/gpa-calculator calculate --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/gpa-calculator clear_courses --device <serial> --param confirm=<confirm>
```

## Actions

- `set_scheme`: Use the MBA grading scheme in the GPA calculator
- `add_course`: Add a 3 credit course with grade A to the GPA calculator
- `get_courses`: Show the courses in the GPA calculator
- `calculate`: Calculate my semester GPA
- `clear_courses`: Clear all the courses in the GPA calculator
